parameters.formDescription: Paste the table Perplexity or Gemini gave you (markdown table, CSV or tab-separated, with a header row such as Company, Website, Email, Location, Notes). New leads land in the review checkpoint; duplicates are skipped.

values.formSubmittedText: Leads received. Open http://localhost:5678/webhook/lead-review to approve them.

parameters.content:
## 1 · INTAKE
Paste Perplexity / Gemini tables into the form (open the Form node → Test URL / Production URL). Duplicates are skipped; new leads go to the review checkpoint.

## 2 · ENRICH
Runs daily 09:00 (or click Test workflow). Visits each new lead's own site, finds a public contact email and scores persona fit 1-10.

## 3 · REVIEW CHECKPOINT (human in the loop)
Open http://localhost:5678/webhook/lead-review to approve / reject leads. Nothing is emailed until approved here.

## 4 · DAILY SENDER
Weekdays 11:00. Sends up to 10 approved leads/day. Starts in TEST MODE: open the 'Pick Todays Batch' code node and set TEST_ADDRESS, your name/role/company and the offer before going live.

## 5 · REPLY WATCHER
Watches the email inbox. A reply stops follow-ups; a bounce marks the address bad.

Daily 10:00. Emails leads with no reply after 3 days. OFF until FOLLOW_UPS_ENABLED = true and the copy is written.
